prompt: A photograph from a lens fixed near the ceiling at the foot of an attic bed, looking along it at night in dim night-mode grain. Brandon sleeps on his back under a neat duvet, mouth slightly open, brows smooth, eyelids closed. A strip of dental floss lies coiled on a wooden crate beside the bed next to a glass of water. A bar of streetlight orange comes through a small window and lies across the floorboards. The rest is deep shadow, washed out and compressed. Thanks.
